A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable versions of the same BIOSCAN-TRAITS study. The main text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A-L support reliable comparison, including matching the renumbered appendix figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original expert-rated trait-generation experiments, ablations, runtime measurements and downstream species-classification results in Tables 1-5 and Appendices B and E.

after.justification: v3 retains original empirical results, including expert ratings and their standard deviations in Appendix B, feature comparisons in Appendix E, and BioCLIP classification accuracies in Table 5.

M1.justification: The DINOv2 features, ReLU SAE objective, species/genus frequency filtering in Algorithm 1, and MLLM prompting procedure remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix C.

E1.justification: Both retain the same reported BIOSCAN-5M/BIOSCAN-TRAITS coverage, BIOSCAN-derived 1,000-species benchmark, and Insects evaluation. Removing one appendix illustration does not establish a change to the datasets or evaluated populations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Figure 2 and Tables 1, 5, B.3 and E.6, including Grad-CAM, MLLM-only, the MLLM and feature-backbone comparisons, and BioCLIP baselines. The deleted qualitative example does not change these comparison sets.

E3.justification: The evaluation retains 30 sampled descriptions per configuration, three expert raters, the five-point rubric, and the same input sizes and fine-tuning settings. Appendix E retains its 20-training/30-test-images-per-species protocol.

E4.justification: Appendix K.1 removes the Islandiana cristata qualitative comparison of MLLM-only versus MLLM + SAE, shown in v1 Figure K.15. The remaining case studies and quantitative ablations of image count, sparsity, frequency threshold, MLLM choice and feature backbone are retained.

E5.justification: Appendix B retains the same rating standard-deviation reporting, and the rater-normalization procedure is unchanged. No seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance-testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: The Islandiana cristata qualitative output comparison in v1 Figure K.15 is removed. All quantitative results remain unchanged, including Table 5's trait-fine-tuned BioCLIP and BioCLIP 2 accuracies of 39.9% and 56.23%; subsequent appendix examples are retained under new numbering.

T1.justification: SAE equations (1)-(4), normalized-frequency definitions, Algorithm 1's selection rule and stated assumptions are unchanged. The revised sparsity explanation is informal; no mathematical derivation or proof is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: SAE-guided morphological annotation, approximately 80K annotations over 19K images, and improved downstream species classification. The main claims retain their scope.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 replaces the asserted reconstruction/recall explanation with an explicit hypothesis that reduced sparsity provides broader, more stable part proposals and fewer missed regions. Appendix A's limitations are unchanged, and the stronger recall wording remains in the captions of Tables 2 and B.2.

D1.justification: The page-1 access footnote changes from the GitHub repository to the project website. The reproducibility statement retains the repository and dataset links, while prompts, hyperparameters, hardware and runtime details remain unchanged. This updates access guidance without establishing changed resource availability.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, scholarly references and scientific positioning are unchanged. Added Funcapalooza and funding acknowledgements do not introduce new research comparisons.

P1.justification: Localized edits add Figure 2 and Table 5 cross-references, rewrite the sparsity explanation, expand acknowledgements and update appendix references. The overall narrative and section organization remain stable.

P2.justification: v1 Figure K.15 is removed; Figures K.16-K.19 become K.15-K.18 and are redistributed across pages 27-29. Sections K.3 and L consequently reflow, leaving the final example alone on page 29. Main-text figures and table layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 improves interpretive caution by explicitly labeling the sparsity mechanism as a hypothesis. It also removes v1 Figure K.15, whose description box duplicates Figure K.14 despite different species images, reducing a potentially misleading illustration. One qualitative case is lost, and stronger recall wording remains in table captions; the unchanged methods and quantitative evidence limit the overall gain.
